title: Existence and uniqueness of conformal Gauduchon metrics
summary: In this paper, we prove that every Hermitian conformal class on a connected noncompact complex manifold of dimension at least two contains a Gauduchon metric. We give a sufficient condition for uniqueness of such Gauduchon metrics up to scaling in terms of functions bounded from above and their Levi forms. This condition is necessary when the manifold has at least two ends. In that case, uniqueness in a fixed conformal class is equivalent to the assertion that every positive solution of the complex Laplace equation for a metric in that class is constant.
